targets.label: Fitness
targets.notes: Known FM27 semantic targets; Condition/Sharpness target scale reaches 10000.

targets.label: Happiness
targets.notes: Change one observable state only before compare.

targets.label: Transfer Proposal
targets.notes: Best witness: one offer added or removed while the player and clubs stay unchanged.

targets.label: Future Transfer
targets.notes: Use before/after confirmed transfer agreement.

targets.label: Relationship • edit existing
targets.notes: Element already reads existing club ties. Change only strength/reason on one existing relation for first write witness.

targets.label: Relationship • add/remove
targets.notes: Add exactly one LikesTeam/LikesPerson relation, capture, then remove the same row to identify vector allocation and deletion semantics.

targets.label: Registration / Homegrown
targets.notes: Change one registration or formed-at relation only.

targets.label: Other Nationality
targets.notes: Add/remove one secondary nationality relation.

targets.label: Work Permit
targets.notes: Use one conditional/permanent permit change and avoid changing contract or club simultaneously.

targets.label: Promises
targets.notes: Add/edit/remove one promise only; object/vector mapping expected.

targets.label: Career Plans
targets.notes: Edit one existing plan first; insertion can follow after row layout is certified.

targets.label: Match Stats / Data Hub
targets.notes: Capture before and after one completed match; use a player who actually records touches/actions.

targets.label: Bans / Unavailability
targets.notes: Use a single known ban/unavailability state change.

targets.label: Injury Record
targets.notes: Prefer an existing minor injury; edit one date/severity field before testing insertion/removal.

targets.label: Retirement
targets.notes: Use a known retirement state change.

targets.label: Languages
targets.notes: Edit one existing language value, then add/remove one language row.

targets.label: Staff Knowledge
targets.notes: Edit one existing staff knowledge entry first.

targets.label: Player Clauses
targets.notes: Club-side clause rows are a separate object family; map one existing clause before creating one.

targets.label: Club Affiliations
targets.notes: Edit one existing affiliation field only.

targets.label: Club Ownership
targets.notes: Only for clubs with an ownership record.

targets.label: Stadium Move
targets.notes: Only for clubs with an existing planned move.
